description: This file defines the interface for RTL8367C switch device's 802.1X (port-based network access control) features, including enums, function prototypes for configuration and retrieval of port-based authentication settings, and related constants.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsic1xPBEnConfig
methods.description: Sets the port-based 802.1X enable configuration for a specified port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsic1xPBEnConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the port-based 802.1X enable configuration for a specified port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsic1xPBAuthConfig
methods.description: Sets the authentication configuration for a specified port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsic1xPBAuthConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication configuration for a specified port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsic1xPBOpdirConfig
methods.description: Sets the operational direction configuration for a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsic1xPBOpdirConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the operational direction configuration for a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsic1xMBEnConfig
methods.description: Enables or disables the MAC-based 802.1X for a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsic1xMBEnConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC-based 802.1X enable status for a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsic1xMBOpdirConfig
methods.description: Sets the operational direction for MAC-based 802.1X.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsic1xMBOpdirConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the operational direction for MAC-based 802.1X.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsic1xProcConfig
methods.description: Configures processing related to 802.1X for a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsic1xProcConfig
methods.description: Retrieves processing configuration for 802.1X on a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsic1xGuestVidx
methods.description: Sets the guest VLAN index for 802.1X.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsic1xGuestVidx
methods.description: Gets the guest VLAN index for 802.1X.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsic1xGVOpdir
methods.description: Sets the operational direction for GVLAN in 802.1X.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsic1xGVOpdir
methods.description: Gets the operational direction status for GVLAN in 802.1X.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsic1xTrapPriority
methods.description: Sets the trap priority level for 802.1X events.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsic1xTrapPriority
methods.description: Gets the trap priority level for 802.1X events.
